paragraphs.text: A water filter jug has two main parts. Tap water is poured into an upper container called the reservoir. It then passes slowly through a cartridge filled with tiny grains of charcoal, which trap chlorine and some metals, before collecting in the jug below. Most cartridges should be replaced every four weeks.
